saw_lines: Skincare buyers judge a serum by its first week on skin, then reorder only when the bottle runs low.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a shopper decides whether a new brand deserves a second look.
Your ads show a proof number in 0 of 24 copy ads. Collect one, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 12 Oct 2026
points: None of your 24 copy ads shows a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust. Pick one real figure, like a review count or orders shipped, and put it on every creative as the opening line.

2 of your 24 copy ads are creator posts run from the brand page, so the creator’s trust stays on their account. Whitelist both from the creator account and cut three variations, each with a new opening line.
0 of your 24 copy ads carry an offer, and none mentions the bundle your site lists, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Put a first order offer in line one of three new ads.

15 different openings across 24 copy ads, and the biggest opener leads only 4 ads, so no single story builds recognition. Pick the two best openers and rebuild the next batch from them, with four variations of each.

ads_1: Two proven stories rebuilt with proof numbers, tested against a first order offer.
